name: publish_artifact
description: Create an artifact, or publish a new version of one by id, from inline content or a map of files. Pass spaceId to create it in a shared space.

name: get_artifact
description: Get an artifact's metadata and the content of a version (the latest by default).

name: list_artifacts
description: List artifacts, filtered by owner, format, visibility, agent, or update time.

name: search_artifacts
description: Full-text search over titles, descriptions, and extracted text.

name: list_versions
description: List an artifact's versions, with the agent and change note for each.

name: restore_version
description: Restore an earlier version. The restore creates a new version.

name: share_artifact
description: Share an artifact with an email address as viewer or editor.

name: unshare_artifact
description: Remove a person's access to an artifact.

name: set_visibility
description: Set an artifact to private, team, or public.

name: delete_artifact
description: Delete an artifact. It can be recovered for 30 days.

name: create_upload
description: Get a signed upload URL for files too large to publish inline.

name: artifact_data_get
description: Read one document from an artifact's live-page data.

name: artifact_data_list
description: List documents in a collection of an artifact's live-page data.

name: artifact_data_query
description: Find documents in a collection that match a filter.

name: artifact_data_set
description: Create or replace a document in a collection.

name: artifact_data_update
description: Merge fields into an existing document.

name: artifact_data_delete
description: Delete a document from a collection.

name: list_spaces
description: List the spaces you can publish into: your personal space first, then shared spaces where you are an editor or manager. Pass a space's id as publish_artifact's spaceId.
